While the story is very well-crafted and atmospheric, it relies on standard suspense and mystery tropes—returning to an abandoned childhood home, experiencing nostalgia through sensory details (the smell of coffee), and discovering an eerie sign of a recent, unexplained presence (fresh coffee beans and a slamming door). Because it is a brief, plot-driven cliffhanger that utilizes familiar conventions rather than exploring new themes, challenging beliefs, or offering deeper insights into human nature, the average reader will be entertained by the suspense rather than walk away with a unique or original idea.
